allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Ashiana Housing Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Rated, Un-secured, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures amounting to INR 100 Crores (10,000 NCDs having Face Value INR 1,00,000) at its meeting held on July 11, 2025.
